options.name: schema
options.description: Initial schema (root type object). Default: an empty form.

options.name: fieldTypes
options.description: Field types offered in the palette, in order. Default: all 18.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon overrides: undo, redo, remove, handle.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of the builder's messages and controls.

properties.name: selected
properties.description: Selected field name, or null (form settings).

properties.name: canUndo
properties.description: Whether there is a step to undo.

properties.name: canRedo
properties.description: Whether there is a step to redo.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Replace the document (validated, undoable, no event).

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Add a field after the selection or at index; returns its name.

methods.name: removeField
methods.description: Remove a field and the conditions that use it.

methods.name: selectField
methods.description: Select a field, or null for the form settings.

methods.name: undo | redo
methods.description: Step through the history (also Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+Shift+Z outside text fields).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge options; a new schema or uiSchema replaces the document and clears the history.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroy every control and empty the host.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The document changed (edit, reorder, import, undo, redo): { schema, uiSchema }, always valid for Schema Form.

cssClasses.name: aui-form-builder__palette | __types | __type
cssClasses.description: Field type list and its buttons.

cssClasses.name: aui-form-builder__canvas | __drop
cssClasses.description: Field list (Sortable List) and the drop line while dragging a type.

cssClasses.name: aui-form-builder__item | __item--selected | __select
cssClasses.description: A field on the canvas, the selected one, and its select button.

cssClasses.name: aui-form-builder__preview | __output
cssClasses.description: Schema Form preview and the submitted value.
